cohort: 27,357 infants born in breech presentation and 837,494 infants born in cephalic presentation in Sweden between 2001 and 2012
finding: Infants delivered vaginally in breech presentation had a significantly higher risk of severe neonatal complications compared to infants delivered by elective caesarean section.
mod_finding: Vaginal breech delivery was associated with significantly increased risks of severe neonatal complications compared to elective caesarean section for breech presentation.
